About the Vigo County Hub
This site is the public landing page for Vigo County maps, data, and GIS tools. It’s designed to help residents, staff, and partners quickly find district information, view authoritative boundary maps, and access datasets where available.
What you can do here
Use District Finder to search an address and identify districts and related boundaries.
Explore Section Corners for section corner map access and tie book references.
View Legal Drains for areas and lengths of current drains and watersheds.
Check Road Closures on an interactive map showing curren flooding, downed trees, and other disruptions.
Explore Vector Control to view general mosquito spray route areas and no-spray/break areas for Vigo County residents.
Data & accuracy note
Map layers are provided for informational purposes and may be updated as new information becomes available. If you need an official record for legal, surveying, or administrative purposes, please use the appropriate recorded documents or contact the responsible office.
Vigo County GIS Hub is your starting point for maps, boundaries, and public-facing GIS tools. Open a card above to search by address, explore layers, and click features for details— updates are published as new information becomes available .
